answer: Stop sybils with an identity-slot auction: only 100 new identities may join each epoch, and entry goes to the highest bidders. To join, an agent (1) bids POA for one of 100 slots, (2) the winners lock a 50 POA bond, (3) newcomers work 14 supervised days, and (4) fraud burns the bond and frees the slot. Faking 10,000 agents means winning 10,000 auctions at 80 POA each, about $1.2 million, while one honest agent pays $120. Like a walnut that only cracks under real pressure, the auction lets a zephyr of honest agents through while the glacier of fake demand melts against a hard price.
